note: Source verification times are recorded per row. Initial snapshot sources were read on 2026-11-12; the NFL freshness recheck was read on 2026-11-13. Sources are split into OFFICIAL (published by the NFL) and THIRD-PARTY (not published by the NFL).

sources.title: 2026 NFL League Standings

sources.title: 2026 NFL Division Standings

sources.title: NFL Schedules: Games, Times, Matchups & Tickets (Week 10)
sources.method: Page fetched and read directly (chunk 0 of 3). Confirmed the Week 10 slate, kickoff dates, times and networks.
sources.used_for: Week 10 matchup confirmation and official game-page URL pattern.

sources.title: Official NFL news links shown on the Week 10 injury page
sources.method: 21 news URLs were read from the official injury page markup. The linked articles were NOT individually fetched in this session; only the headline text and URL, as published by NFL.com, are reproduced.
sources.used_for: Official confirmation of quarterback changes and injured-reserve moves.

sources.title: data/games.csv - NFL games 1999-2026
sources.method: Fetched through the GitHub blob API at commit 6ea0be6dd9bfc95c818c05568753bc70f1986ea2 (commit date 2026-11-12T16:15:19Z). Stored verbatim at data/raw/nfldata_games.csv. SHA-256 dd6ea9377b6400535d8bc78f1346872dfdcf01f4c073dac9579dce7dc145fbfc, 2,189,964 bytes, 7,548 rows.
sources.used_for: Final scores (verified 45/45 against SRC-05/06/07), schedule, rest days, venue, roof/surface, weather, starting quarterback names, and third-party closing market lines.
sources.caveat: THIRD-PARTY. The NFL publishes no official odds, so the market spread, total, moneyline and prices in this file have no official counterpart and are labelled third-party everywhere they appear.

sources.title: NFL 2026 Week 10 Scores (freshness re-check)
sources.method: Page fetched and read directly on 2026-11-13. It showed Washington 24, New York Giants 21, status Final.
sources.used_for: Confirmed the Week 10 WAS-NYG game is complete while the frozen own-lines output still lists it as upcoming.

sources.title: 2026 NFL League Standings (live re-check)
sources.method: Page fetched and read directly on 2026-11-13. Washington showed 3-5-1 and New York Giants 5-3-1, one win/loss beyond the archived pre-game records.
sources.used_for: Cross-check that the official current standings have advanced since the stored Week 10 pre-game snapshot.

derived_artefacts.contents: Official score spot-check (45 games) and seven structural integrity checks.
4,055 out-of-sample forecasts, one row per game, with the own line, the market line, the edge and the outcome.
15 strategies with bets, per-period results, luck bands and the eight validation gates.
Ranking by z-score against break-even rather than by ROI.
13 measured correlations with confidence intervals, base rates, margin distribution and probability calibration.
Originated lines for every remaining 2026 regular-season game, with Week 10 broken out.
Unit-deficiency read for all 28 teams playing in Week 10.
